g.text: TWO-JOINT DIFFERENTIAL TX BANK - REVIEW CIRCUIT r0.1

g.desc: TWO-JOINT DIFFERENTIAL TX BANK - REVIEW CIRCUIT r0.1

g.text: Repeat 3x for six joints. No PCB, external protection or system inhibit circuit is released.

g.desc: Repeat 3x for six joints. No PCB, external protection or system inhibit circuit is released.

g.text: U1 pin map checked against TI SLLS103P Figure4-1 (PW16). Supply4.5-5.5V; logic VIH>=2V/VIL<=0.8V.

g.desc: U1 pin map checked against TI SLLS103P Figure4-1 (PW16). Supply4.5-5.5V; logic VIH>=2V/VIL<=0.8V.

g.text: 3.3V source required; no 5V pull-up on FPGA-connected nets. Inputs must not drive an unpowered U1.

g.desc: 3.3V source required; no 5V pull-up on FPGA-connected nets. Inputs must not drive an unpowered U1.

g.text: R1-R4 are initial source-damping provisions; R5-R9 force low with upstream high-Z. Re-evaluate SI in layout.

g.desc: R1-R4 are initial source-damping provisions; R5-R9 force low with upstream high-Z. Re-evaluate SI in layout.

g.text: G=0 and /G=1 -> differential outputs HIGH-Z. TX_PERMIT must come from qualified hardware permission.

g.desc: G=0 and /G=1 -> differential outputs HIGH-Z. TX_PERMIT must come from qualified hardware permission.

g.text: HIGH-Z is not guaranteed STEP-low at the remote drive: qualified receiver bias and drive inhibit are mandatory.

g.desc: HIGH-Z is not guaranteed STEP-low at the remote drive: qualified receiver bias and drive inhibit are mandatory.
